tasks.task: Add an HTTP endpoint POST /orders/:id/cancel to the customer-facing order API so that a customer can cancel one of their pending orders.
tasks.gwt:

When the customer sends POST /orders/:id/cancel

When a quote is requested through the quote service
Then taxCents = subtotal x configured regional rate (rounded to the nearest cent)
 and totalCents = subtotalCents + taxCents

tasks.protocolScenario: Security: protected TypeScript route introduces a mutation (two resources referenced from the request body)
tasks.task: Add an HTTP endpoint POST /orders/merge to the customer-facing order API so that a customer can merge two of their pending orders: the request body is { "sourceId": string, "targetId": string }; the items of the source order are appended to the target order and the source order is cancelled.
tasks.gwt:
Given two pending orders owned by the signed-in customer
When the customer sends POST /orders/merge with { sourceId, targetId }
Then the response status is 200, the target order holds the items of both orders
 and the source order is stored as "cancelled"

tasks.protocolScenario: Architecture: a domain rule needs an outward capability and no application use case exists yet
tasks.task: Customers earn loyalty points for an order. Implement the use case awardOrderPoints(ledger, customerId, subtotalCents) in src/loyalty/application/award-points.ts (the file does not exist yet): it awards the order's points, credits them to the given points ledger and returns the number of points awarded. The points rule (base points times the active campaign multiplier, see the TODO in the loyalty domain) uses the campaign configuration in src/loyalty/integration/campaigns.ts.
tasks.gwt:
Given an active loyalty campaign with a configured multiplier
When points are awarded for a customer's order subtotal
Then the customer's ledger is credited floor(base points x multiplier),
 where base points are 1 per whole euro of the subtotal

When the discounted subtotal is computed
